_comment: SUFUN Firefox defaults. JSON has no comments, so they are here; Firefox ignores this key.
uBlock Origin: installed for every user from the bundled, Mozilla-signed copy (package sufun-ublock-origin, works offline),
'normal_installed' = ON by default but the user CAN switch it off in about:addons (never locked); it updates itself from addons.mozilla.org.
Per site: uBlock's own power button. Lists: uBlock's defaults + the Korean list (KOR-1). No other extensions.
Memory (4 GB): unload background tabs when memory gets low (Linux: off by default in Firefox), earlier than Firefox's 5 %;
max_total_viewers=0: Back reloads the page instead of keeping old pages in RAM; fewer content processes.
Site isolation (Fission) stays ON. No security setting is changed.
Graphics: hardware WebRender and VA-API video decoding (the UHD 615 decodes VP9/H.264, not AV1).
allow-pipewire: video calls use the Surface cameras through PipeWire/libcamera.
All of these are defaults ('Status: default'): users can change them in about:config / Settings.
